channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jay Triano | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jay Triano from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Devin Booker on Jay Triano
item.description:
“I love Triano. I don’t make those calls (hiring a coach) but he’s been doing a wonderful job since he’s been here and I would vouch for him. He’s been really good.”

Devin Booker on Jay Triano, Dec 18, 2017. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Devin Booker on Jay Triano
item.description:
Booker said Monday that he’d like to see Phoenix retain interim coach Jay Triano,who has led the Suns to a 10-18 record since taking over for the fired Earl Watson three games into the season.

“Me and Triano have that relationship. He’s somebody I’m comfortable with and somebody I’ve been around for a long time,”

Devin Booker on Jay Triano, Dec 18, 2017. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Bryan Colangelo on Jay Triano
item.description:
Bryan Colangelo on Jay Triano:

“Clearly he did everything we asked him to do this year. He stuck to that plan”

Bryan Colangelo on Jay Triano, Apr 18, 2011. Source: FAN590.
